data.title: Null Invaders 0.7
data.subtitle: Louder, and ready for thumbs.
lead: Null Invaders 0.7 adds sound and a proper phone cockpit: an analog joystick and a round Fire button you can hold while you fly. Null Invaders is the shooter where you fly an interceptor through a real webpage, turn letters into binary and break the button factories.

body.text: Firing, hits, weapon upgrades and new waves now have synthesized sound cues.
On phones, the arrow pad becomes an analog joystick with eight-way flight. Fire is the round crosshair button from DOM Battlefield, with a 3D press. Fly and hold Fire together.
The scoreboard shares its controls with the other games: sound, pause or resume, minimize and Recall.
Pulse, Twin, Trident and Overdrive still unlock as you earn combat XP. Destroyed factories still stop spawning for the rest of the wave.
The controls come from the shared DOM VIRUS runtime, snapshot 0.21.0. The gzip budget grew by 2 KB to pay for them and now sits at 24,000 bytes.
Setup, configuration and integration examples live in the repository README.

seo.title: Null Invaders 0.7: combat sound and a phone joystick
seo.description: Null Invaders 0.7 adds firing, hit, upgrade and wave sounds, an analog joystick and a held Fire button on phones. 22.9 kB gzip, game + engine.
